description: This file contains utility functions for message translation, content processing, file handling, schema dereferencing, and content type inference within a larger AI/ML project, specifically related to prompt handling and message formatting.

classes.name: ExtractedFileData
classes.description: Data class representing extracted file information including filename, content bytes, MIME type, and headers.

methods.name: handle_any_messages_to_chat_completion_str_messages_conversion
methods.description: Converts various message formats (list, dict, str) into a list of string-input dictionaries for chat completion.

methods.name: handle_messages_with_content_list_to_str_conversion
methods.description: Converts message content lists into concatenated strings for compatibility.

methods.name: strip_name_from_message
methods.description: Removes 'name' key from a message if its role is not in allowed roles.

methods.name: strip_name_from_messages
methods.description: Removes 'name' key from each message in a list based on role.

methods.name: strip_none_values_from_message
methods.description: Removes keys with None values from a message dictionary.

methods.name: convert_content_list_to_str
methods.description: Concatenates list content or returns string content from a message.

methods.name: get_str_from_messages
methods.description: Concatenates all messages into a single string.

methods.name: is_non_content_values_set
methods.description: Checks if a message has non-content, non-role, non-name values set.

methods.name: _audio_or_image_in_message_content
methods.description: Checks if message content contains audio or image types.

methods.name: convert_openai_message_to_only_content_messages
methods.description: Converts messages to only role and content dictionaries for specific integrations.

methods.name: get_content_from_model_response
methods.description: Extracts concatenated content from a model response object.

methods.name: detect_first_expected_role
methods.description: Determines the next expected role ('user' or 'assistant') based on message sequence.

methods.name: _insert_user_continue_message
methods.description: Inserts a user continue message between assistant messages to ensure role alternation.

methods.name: _insert_assistant_continue_message
methods.description: Inserts assistant continue messages between consecutive user messages.

methods.name: get_completion_messages
methods.description: Ensures message role alternation by inserting placeholder messages as needed.

methods.name: get_format_from_file_id
methods.description: Extracts format info from a file ID, especially for managed files.

methods.name: update_messages_with_model_file_ids
methods.description: Replaces file IDs in messages with provider-specific IDs based on a mapping.

methods.name: update_responses_input_with_model_file_ids
methods.description: Updates API input content with provider-specific file IDs, decoding unified IDs if needed.

methods.name: extract_file_data
methods.description: Extracts filename, content bytes, MIME type, and headers from various file input formats.

methods.name: unpack_defs
methods.description: Recursively resolves JSON schema $ref references into full definitions.

methods.name: _get_image_mime_type_from_url
methods.description: Returns MIME type based on URL extension for common image/video/audio types.

methods.name: infer_content_type_from_url_and_content
methods.description: Infers MIME type from URL extension or binary content signature, raising error if unknown.

methods.name: get_tool_call_names
methods.description: Extracts function names from a list of tool parameters.

methods.name: is_function_call
methods.description: Checks if optional parameters indicate a function call.

methods.name: get_file_ids_from_messages
methods.description: Retrieves all file IDs referenced in user messages.

methods.name: check_is_function_call
methods.description: Determines if a logging object indicates a function call based on optional params.

methods.name: filter_value_from_dict
methods.description: Removes specified key from nested dictionaries and lists up to a max depth.

methods.name: migrate_file_to_image_url
methods.description: Converts a file message into an image URL message object.

methods.name: get_last_user_message
methods.description: Retrieves the last block of user messages concatenated into a string.

methods.name: set_last_user_message
methods.description: Replaces the last block of user messages with a new message.

methods.name: convert_prefix_message_to_non_prefix_messages
methods.description: Converts prefix messages into standard message format with system prompt.

methods.name: _extract_reasoning_content
methods.description: Extracts reasoning content and main message content, parsing special tags.

methods.name: _parse_content_for_reasoning
methods.description: Uses regex to parse reasoning tags from message content.

methods.name: extract_images_from_message
methods.description: Extracts image URLs from message content.
